validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE + SPEC: the sheet's own current_ref (http://fgw.gxzf.gov.cn/zfxxgkzl/wjzx/xmpf/xiangmuhezhunpifu/t2198133.shtml) times out from this environment (ConnectTimeout on every gxzf.gov.cn subdomain tried — a network-access issue, not evidence the page doesn't exist: a Google-indexed snippet for the project code '2018-451029-57-02-036320' shows its exact title, 'Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Development and Reform Commission's approval of the Baise-Tianlin natural gas branch pipeline project', confirming the page is real and on-topic). I located and fully read the underlying document verbatim as republished by an independent trade portal, archived and verified live: 关于广西天然气支线管网项目 百色—田林天然气支线管道工程项目核准的批复 (Guangxi RDC approval no. 桂发改油气〔2019〕705号, dated 2019-07-12, published by gas.in-en.com 2019-07-25). This is a genuine primary regulatory approval document, not a GEM-derived or aggregate citation, and it names this exact project. It states verbatim: project code 2018-451029-57-02-036320; construction unit 广西广投天然气管网有限公司 (Guangxi Guangtou Natural Gas Pipeline Network Co Ltd); location 百色市右江区 (Youjiang District, Baise) through 田林县 (Tianlin County); route length 'approximately 92 km' (~80km in Youjiang District + ~12km in Tianlin County) -- EXACT MATCH to GEM LengthKnown=92.00km; design capacity '3.64亿立方米/年' = 0.364 bcm/y -- MATCHES GEM Capacity=0.36 bcm/y; design pressure '4MPa' -- EXACT MATCH to GEM Pressure=4.00 MPa; pipe diameter 'D323.9' -- EXACT MATCH to GEM Diameter=323.90mm; total investment '约36421.62万元' = RMB 364,216,200 -- MATCHES GEM SegmentCost=364,200,000.00 RMB (within 0.005%); and project owner/legal-person 广西广投天然气管网有限公司 -- EXACT MATCH to GEM Owner1='Guangxi Guangtou Natural Gas Pipeline Network Co Ltd' and the operators/owners tab's QCCOwner field. Every independently checkable numeric and entity field in the sheet matches this primary document precisely -- strong internal corroboration even though it is one underlying document (the government's own notice, reproduced by a second, independent trade-news domain). I made a genuine effort to find a fully separate second source (targeted Chinese-language web searches for the project by name, by approval-document number, for EPC/tender announcements, for Baise/Tianlin county-government gas-connection news, and image-read of an archive.org screenshot of a related Baise energy-sector safety-production plan) but found none -- this is a small (92km, sub-1-bcm/y) county-level branch line with limited independent media footprint, unlike its much larger sibling projects (e.g. Baise-Wenshan) which get national coverage. Tier=medium (one strong, directly on-topic primary regulatory source; genuinely searched for and could not find a second independent one). CLASSIFICATION: correctly a natural-gas transmission branch pipeline (支线管道) built to extend county-level gas access per the region's 'county-to-county gas access' program (县县通天然气工程) -- not a gathering/process line. DUPLICATE check against the 43-row Guangxi roster: no match -- P4724 is the only row at 92km/323.9mm/0.36bcm/y with Youjiang District->Guangxi endpoints; the nearest-diameter rows (P7656 8.9km/0.67bcm/y, P7657 45km/0.42bcm/y, P4718 29km) are clearly different, shorter branches. No duplicate or misfiling found.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The most recent dated, independent evidence I can find naming this specific project is its own 2019-07-12/07-25 core approval (桂发改油气〔2019〕705号) -- nearly 7 years ago. The approval document itself warns that if construction has not begun within 2 years of approval, the developer must apply for an extension (max +1 year, one extension only) -- i.e. the document's own terms expect construction to start by ~2021-2022 absent a filed extension, which I found no record of. I searched extensively for any newer, project-specific evidence: general Tianlin-county gas-connection/'gas turned on' news (2023-2025), EPC/tender-bid databases for '百色-田林' or '田林天然气支线', the Tianlin county government's own news portal (tianlin.gxbsrd.gov.cn), and a 2024-03 Baise municipal energy-sector safety-production three-year plan (2024-2026) that cites a 'baisetianlin'-tagged document on the wiki page -- I retrieved and visually read that document's cover page (百发改能源〔2024〕19号) but it is a generic sector-wide safety directive, not project-specific evidence of this branch's construction status, and I could not locate body text naming this pipeline. No construction, tender, EIA-filing, or gas-flow news for this specific branch turned up anywhere, in contrast to the same wiki page's much larger sibling project (Baise-Wenshan LNG pipeline), which has a clear, well-documented public trail (EIA approved 2023, broke ground Aug 2024). The sheet's own LastUpdated (2025-08-25) does not correspond to any new evidence I could find for this specific segment and looks like a housekeeping/batch touch rather than a re-verification. Applying the dormancy rule: proposed with no found progress for >=2 years (actually ~7 years) -> presumed shelved. No fabricated ref for the presumption itself; the cited URL supports only the last confirmed evidence date (the 2019 approval), not the shelved status.

summary: P4724 (Baise-Tianlin Branch, part of Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network) is a real, correctly classified, non-duplicate transmission branch: its own 2019-07-25 Guangxi RDC core-approval notice (republished by gas.in-en.com, archived and verified live -- the sheet's own gxzf.gov.cn current_ref times out from this network but is independently confirmed to exist via a Google-indexed snippet for the same project code) matches every spec field in the sheet almost exactly (92km length, 323.9mm diameter, 4MPa pressure, 0.36 bcm/y capacity, RMB 364.2M cost, owner). Staged 3 verified ref fills (Fuel, Operator, Owner) plus one UNRESOLVED (FuelSource, unverifiable, left blank rather than fabricated). Main open finding: Status='proposed' looks stale -- no construction/progress evidence found in ~7 years since approval -- flagged verdict='stale', proposed Status='shelved' (Presumed) pending a fresh targeted search or direct confirmation.
